Brad, saw Vetty landed on Nucleus Research's Hot Companies to Watch in 2026, one of only eleven named.

That kind of momentum usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before the message lands. That is where pipeline goes cold: reps spend hours on research, writing, and CRM instead of meetings. Our AI SDR runs all of that autonomously, so growth scales without new headcount, around 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Vetty off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?

Brad, quick follow-up for Vetty.

As growth officer, your pipeline expectation tends to outrun headcount, especially across healthcare, staffing, and gig where demand is broad. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Vetty needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Vetty's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
